name: Mythic+: client data at login
contract: At login the server sends what the client needs for Mythic+ and the Classic Heroics and Mythics without an addon: three Lua strings, the champion count per dungeon, and this week's affix rows with Tiny swapped out.

steps.label: A champion count for every timed dungeon (SMSG_PATCH_TIMED_DUNGEON)
Affix rows with Tiny swapped out (SMSG_PATCH_MYTHIC_AFFIXES)
